senses.gloss: (√בר; cmp. ברז, v. P. Sm. 618) to break through.
to cut through from end to end. Part. Pu. מְבוֹרָץ.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 3:10">Tosef. Kil. III, 10</cite> <he>חריץ המב׳</he> a ditch which is cut through, going from end to end of the vineyard (Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 1:2">Men. I, 2</cite> <he>קמצו מב׳</he> the priest’s grasp of the meal offering must be coming forth on both sides.
